lines.zh: 八条腿在沙上留下一串细痕。
lines.en: Eight legs leave a row of fine marks in the sand.

lines.zh: 沙粒烫，我抬高了几条腿。
lines.en: The sand's hot; I lift a few legs higher.

lines.zh: 两把钳子举在身前，随时能夹。
lines.en: Both pincers held forward, ready to pinch.

lines.zh: 尾巴弯成一道弧，尖朝前。
lines.en: My tail curves in an arc, point aimed forward.

lines.zh: 我贴着岩石的阴影走。
lines.en: I keep to the shade along the rock face.

lines.zh: 白天沙面太亮，我往低处去。
lines.en: The daytime sand's too bright; I head lower.

lines.zh: 壳擦过碎石，发出细响。
lines.en: My shell scrapes the gravel with a thin sound.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，但每一步都稳。
lines.en: I move slowly, but every step holds.

lines.zh: 沙下有东西动，我停了一下。
lines.en: Something stirs beneath the sand; I pause.

lines.zh: 面前是仙人掌，我绕开它的刺。
lines.en: A cactus ahead; I steer clear of its spines.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，风就吹不透。
lines.en: I flatten low so the wind can't get under me.

lines.zh: 夜里凉下来，我才走得快。
lines.en: Once the night cools, my pace picks up.

lines.zh: 沙丘的坡太松，我横着走。
lines.en: The dune's too loose; I cross it sideways.

lines.zh: 一路过去，尾巴扫平了沙纹。
lines.en: My tail smooths the ripples as I pass.

lines.zh: 我把沙拨到身后，盖住自己的痕。
lines.en: I sweep sand behind me to cover my trail.

lines.zh: 悬崖的阴影变长了，我往那边走。
lines.en: The cliff shadow grew longer; I head for it.

lines.zh: 我伏在沙里，只露出尾尖。
lines.en: I lie in the sand with only my tail tip showing.

lines.zh: 钳子慢慢开合，像在磨刀。
lines.en: My pincers open and close, slowly, like honing.

lines.zh: 太阳烤着壳，我一点也不热。
lines.en: The sun bakes my shell and I don't mind.

lines.zh: 毒囊鼓着，里面还有存货。
lines.en: My venom sac is full; there's more where that came from.

lines.zh: 我等一只甲虫从石头下爬出来。
lines.en: I wait for a beetle to crawl from under the stone.

lines.zh: 风把沙吹到我背上，我不动。
lines.en: Wind piles sand on my back; I stay still.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴收回来，绕到身侧。
lines.en: I draw my tail in and curl it by my side.

lines.zh: 沙漠太安静，只有我的壳响。
lines.en: The desert's so quiet only my shell clicks.

lines.zh: 一只蜥蜴跑过，我没追。
lines.en: A lizard darts past; I let it go.

lines.zh: 我数着沙粒落下的声音。
lines.en: I count the sound of grains sliding down.

lines.zh: 月亮升起来，我才睁开眼。
lines.en: I open my eyes only when the moon rises.

lines.zh: 这片沙地是我的，边界在那边。
lines.en: This stretch of sand is mine, out to that ridge.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的沙了。
lines.en: You've stepped on my sand.

lines.zh: 我抬起尾巴，你能看见尖。
lines.en: I raise my tail so you can see the tip.

lines.zh: 你的靴子太近，退半步。
lines.en: Your boot's too close; half a step back.

lines.zh: 我八只眼都对着你。
lines.en: All eight of my eyes are on you.

lines.zh: 你不像食物，也不像天敌。
lines.en: You're neither food nor a natural enemy.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我就往后缩。
lines.en: You crouch, and I shrink backward.

lines.zh: 我认出那根火把了，别挥。
lines.en: I know that torch; don't wave it about.

lines.zh: 沙漠里来的人，多半不怀好意。
lines.en: People who come to the desert rarely mean well.

lines.zh: 你不动，我就先转开视线。
lines.en: If you hold still, I'll look away first.

lines.zh: 我的影子在你脚边，看清了。
lines.en: My shadow's at your feet — take a good look.

lines.zh: 背甲上裂开一道，风灌进去。
lines.en: A crack opens in my back plate and wind gets in.

lines.zh: 我的腿少了一条还能走。
lines.en: One leg fewer and I still walk.

lines.zh: 钳子被打偏，合不上了。
lines.en: My pincer's knocked askew and won't close.

lines.zh: 尾巴缩回来，护在身下。
lines.en: I pull my tail in and shelter it beneath me.

lines.zh: 这一脚把我踩进沙里。
lines.en: That stomp drives me into the sand.

lines.zh: 毒囊被压了一下，很胀。
lines.en: My venom sac got squeezed and feels swollen.

lines.zh: 我往石头底下钻，钻得很急。
lines.en: I scramble under the nearest stone.

lines.zh: 壳里的肉在抽，我走不快。
lines.en: The flesh under my shell twitches; I slow.

lines.zh: 你打碎了我半片背甲。
lines.en: You've cracked half my back plate.

lines.zh: 我举起尾巴，可抬不太高。
lines.en: I raise my tail, but it won't lift far.

lines.zh: 你手里那只虫子还在动。
lines.en: The bug in your hand is still wriggling.

lines.zh: 放下，然后退开三步。
lines.en: Put it down, then back off three steps.

lines.zh: 我闻到甲虫的腥味了。
lines.en: I can smell beetle on it.

lines.zh: 钳子已经伸出去了，别缩手。
lines.en: My pincers are out; don't pull your hand back.

lines.zh: 这点东西不够填我的肚子。
lines.en: That's not enough to fill me.

lines.zh: 你举得高，我就得爬上来。
lines.en: Hold it high and I'll have to climb you.

lines.zh: 沙里埋着的虫子更肥。
lines.en: The grubs buried in sand are fatter.

lines.zh: 我先夹一下，看它死没死。
lines.en: I pinch it once to see if it's dead.

lines.zh: 你手抖，我就不太敢接。
lines.en: Your hand shakes, so I'm wary of taking it.

lines.zh: 这一口算是你买的平安。
lines.en: Consider this mouthful your peace offering.

lines.zh: 你的脚踢翻了我身上的沙。
lines.en: Your foot kicks the sand off my back.

lines.zh: 壳被撞得咔一声。
lines.en: My shell knocks with a sharp click.

lines.zh: 我甩尾，尖擦过你的裤脚。
lines.en: I flick my tail; the tip grazes your trouser leg.

lines.zh: 别用脚试我的壳硬不硬。
lines.en: Don't test my shell with your boot.

lines.zh: 我被推得滑出半尺。
lines.en: I slide half a foot from the shove.

lines.zh: 你踩住我的腿了，抬脚。
lines.en: You're standing on my leg; lift your foot.

lines.zh: 我钻进沙里，你踩了个空。
lines.en: I sink into the sand and your foot finds nothing.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我的钳子就张开了。
lines.en: One bump and my pincers spring open.

lines.zh: 沙地上我们各退一步。
lines.en: On the sand we each give a step.

lines.zh: 你身上掉下的铁片硌了我的脚。
lines.en: The iron scrap you dropped jabs my leg.

lines.zh: 我用钳子轻轻碰她的钳子。
lines.en: I tap her pincer lightly with mine.

lines.zh: 她的尾巴比我短一截。
lines.en: Her tail is a segment shorter than mine.

lines.zh: 我们在同一块石头下过夜。
lines.en: We spend the night under the same stone.

lines.zh: 我把捕到的甲虫推给她。
lines.en: I push the beetle I caught toward her.

lines.zh: 两只蝎子绕着圈，沙上全是痕。
lines.en: Two scorpions circle, leaving tracks all over.

lines.zh: 她的壳在月光下发亮。
lines.en: Her shell shines faintly in the moonlight.

lines.zh: 我守在洞口，让她先下去。
lines.en: I keep watch at the burrow and let her go first.

lines.zh: 尾巴交叠，那就算是说定了。
lines.en: Our tails overlap; that settles it.

lines.zh: 沙子底下暖和，比风里好。
lines.en: It's warmer under the sand than in the wind.

lines.zh: 等天亮了，我们各走各的。
lines.en: When morning comes, we'll go our own ways.

lines.zh: 我用钳子夹起那片壳。
lines.en: I pick up that shell fragment with a pincer.

lines.zh: 毒腺掉在沙上，我护着它。
lines.en: A poison gland fell on the sand; I guard it.

lines.zh: 这东西不能吃，但能换。
lines.en: This isn't food, but it's worth something.

lines.zh: 我把石头翻过来，底下有货。
lines.en: I flip the stone; something's underneath.

lines.zh: 你丢下的东西，我先闻再说。
lines.en: Whatever you drop, I smell it before I take it.

lines.zh: 钳子太小，夹不住这块。
lines.en: My pincers are too small to grip this.

lines.zh: 掉进沙里的，就别想找回来了。
lines.en: Once it falls in the sand, it's gone for good.

lines.zh: 我把它拖进洞里，慢慢看。
lines.en: I drag it into my burrow to look it over.

lines.zh: 碎片边上锋利，我用钳子夹稳。
lines.en: The shard's edge is sharp; I grip it carefully.

lines.zh: 沙会把它埋掉，得快点。
lines.en: The sand will bury it; I'd better hurry.

lines.zh: 那边沙在动，我盯上了。
lines.en: The sand's shifting over there; I'm on it.

lines.zh: 你踩下的脚印太深，我循着走。
lines.en: Your prints sink deep; I follow them.

lines.zh: 那只甲虫钻进石缝，我记住了。
lines.en: The beetle slipped under a stone; I marked it.

lines.zh: 你手里拿着火把，我先盯你。
lines.en: You carry a torch, so I watch you first.

lines.zh: 这个方向来的震动，不是风。
lines.en: That tremor isn't the wind.

lines.zh: 我把身体转向西边。
lines.en: I turn my body toward the west.

lines.zh: 有东西在沙丘背面走。
lines.en: Something walks on the far side of the dune.

lines.zh: 你的脚步乱了，我听得出来。
lines.en: Your steps went uneven; I can hear it.

lines.zh: 尾尖抬起来，对准那个影子。
lines.en: My tail tip rises, aimed at that shape.

lines.zh: 我认定你了，别装作路过。
lines.en: I've picked you; don't pretend to pass by.

lines.zh: 那根火把的光，我一辈子记得。
lines.en: I'll remember the light of that torch.

lines.zh: 我先伏着，等那边的沙先动。
lines.en: I lie low and wait for that sand to stir.

lines.zh: 我横着挪，始终对着你。
lines.en: I sidestep, always squared up to you.

lines.zh: 钳子一张一合，是在数你的距离。
lines.en: My pincers open and close, measuring the gap.

lines.zh: 你退，我就往前压半步。
lines.en: You back off; I press half a step forward.

lines.zh: 尾巴高举，随时能落下来。
lines.en: My tail's high, ready to come down.

lines.zh: 沙上的脚印告诉我你在哪。
lines.en: The prints in the sand tell me where you are.

lines.zh: 我绕到你的下风口。
lines.en: I circle around to your downwind side.

lines.zh: 别以为我爬得慢就追不上。
lines.en: Don't think slow feet mean I can't reach you.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，壳贴着沙。
lines.en: I flatten down, shell against the sand.

lines.zh: 你每动一下，我的尾巴就抬一点。
lines.en: Each time you move, my tail lifts a little.

lines.zh: 这圈子越缩越小了。
lines.en: This circle keeps getting smaller.

lines.zh: 我等你踩进那片松沙。
lines.en: I'm waiting for you to step into that loose sand.

lines.zh: 你一低头，我就冲过去。
lines.en: The moment you look down, I lunge.

lines.zh: 钳子夹住你的手腕。
lines.en: A pincer closes on your wrist.

lines.zh: 尾针扎进你的小腿。
lines.en: My stinger sinks into your calf.

lines.zh: 毒液进去了，先是麻。
lines.en: The venom's in; first comes the numbness.

lines.zh: 我夹一下，再补一针。
lines.en: One pinch, then a sting to follow.

lines.zh: 钳子只是牵制，针才是真的。
lines.en: The pincers only hold you; the sting's the point.

lines.zh: 你退开时，我的尾巴追上去。
lines.en: As you pull back, my tail follows.

lines.zh: 这一针打在你的靴缝里。
lines.en: The sting finds the seam of your boot.

lines.zh: 我钳住你的袖子，往后拖。
lines.en: I clamp your sleeve and haul backward.

lines.zh: 沙被我们搅得满天。
lines.en: We kick up sand until it fills the air.

lines.zh: 挨了这一下，你该知道疼了。
lines.en: After that, you should know it stings.

lines.zh: 我从沙里钻出来，壳还带着凉。
lines.en: I break out of the sand with a cool shell.

lines.zh: 第一件事是把尾巴展开。
lines.en: The first thing I do is uncurl my tail.

lines.zh: 太阳在我壳上发白。
lines.en: The sun glares white on my new shell.

lines.zh: 我试着夹了一下空气。
lines.en: I snap my pincers at nothing.

lines.zh: 沙丘的影子很长，我朝那边去。
lines.en: The dune's shadow is long; I head for it.

lines.zh: 八条腿第一次一起动。
lines.en: Eight legs move together for the first time.

lines.zh: 毒囊还空着，得先吃东西。
lines.en: My venom sac is empty; I need to eat first.

lines.zh: 我闻到了干土和石头。
lines.en: I smell dry earth and hot stone.

lines.zh: 这片沙漠没有别的蝎子。
lines.en: There are no other scorpions in this desert.

lines.zh: 我先挖个浅坑，把自己藏好。
lines.en: I dig a shallow pit and tuck myself in.

lines.zh: 火烫穿了我的壳，里面在烧。
lines.en: Heat bores through my shell; it burns inside.

lines.zh: 从岩壁上掉下来，壳磕碎了角。
lines.en: I drop off the ledge and chip my shell.

lines.zh: 水灌进壳缝，我翻不过身。
lines.en: Water fills my shell's seams; I can't right myself.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀出老远，腿都散了。
lines.en: The blast throws me far; my legs splay out.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉进我的背甲。
lines.en: An arrow lodges in my back plate.

lines.zh: 蓝光锁住我的腿，一根也动不了。
lines.en: Blue light locks my legs; not one will move.

lines.zh: 沙里找不到虫子，壳都轻了。
lines.en: No grubs in the sand; my shell feels light.

lines.zh: 雷劈在沙上，玻璃结了一层。
lines.en: Lightning hits the sand and leaves glass behind.

lines.zh: 身子底下空空的，连沙也没有。
lines.en: Nothing beneath me at all — not even sand.
